object.description: Setup: an export archive made from a phone with saved workouts, the app installed with no saved workouts, and a text file renamed to .zip. Steps: 1. Select the import row and choose the archive. 2. Compare the workout database with the original. 3. Import the same archive again. 4. Import the renamed text file. Expected: Step 1 reports the number of workouts in the archive as added. In step 2 each workout value, split and route point equals the original. Step 3 reports 0 workouts added and step 4 reports a failure, and the database is unchanged after each.
